svg.title: Choosing a graphical interface
svg.desc: selection guide, four lines of recommendations: macOS 26 or newer choose official Homebrew.app; older system and only manages graphics App choose Applite; need more detailed management selection Cork; prefer terminal selection Bold Brew. Keep the original suggestions and indicate that the official compatibility instructions shall prevail. Rebuild prompt: Produce a standalone native SVG infographic without HTML, scripts or remote dependencies. White background, dark blue text #203047, blue graphics #275fa4, purple distinction item tap, gray distinction not included. Width 1000 pixels, the height adjusts according to the content; labels are clearly wrapped and not cropped; Arabic text is typed from right to left. The text language is English.

g.font-family: Arial, Noto Sans, Noto Sans Arabic, PingFang SC, Microsoft YaHei, sans-serif
